title: An active schedule can be duplicated; the copy has no assets
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an Owner/Admin, or a user with "Settings Service" enabled, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A schedule with at least one asset enrolled, and one not-yet-enrolled asset. Seed it:
  3. ↳ Settings > Maintenance > New schedule "Highway Tractor PM"; Add service PM-A (calendar Every 3 months) and Save.
  4. ↳ Open an asset's Maintenance tab (last tab) -> Enrol -> pick "Highway Tractor PM" to enrol one asset.
  5. ↳ Keep a second asset un-enrolled for comparison.
  6. One archived schedule also exists.
custom_steps:
1. On an active schedule with assets enrolled, open its row menu -> Duplicate; observe the copy's name, where it lands, and whether it opens.
  2. Confirm the copy carries no enrolled assets.
  3. Open an archived schedule's row menu and read its options.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • An active schedule can be duplicated; the copy is named after the original with a numeric suffix, lands beside it in the list, opens for editing, and carries no enrolled assets.
  • An archived schedule offers Restore alone (no Duplicate).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10563 (S6, Edit and archive a schedule); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S6; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
